_note: Korean linguistic data of the core area (linter, AST classification, profiler). build.rs turns each key into a constant in crate::lexicon (string -> &str, array -> &[&str]). Array order is kept exactly; several lists are matched first-to-last and must stay longest-first.
_LINTER_KO_FILLERS: Filler words dropped by the filler pass (the English ones are in linter.rs).
_LINTER_KO_NEG_IMPERATIVES: '-ji ma/mal' prohibitive endings, longest first. Negative when the previous word ends in LINTER_KO_NEG_CONNECTIVE or when glued to such a word.
_LINTER_KO_STOPWORDS: Korean function words left out of content comparison (the English stopwords are in linter.rs).
_LINTER_KO_SUFFIXES: Endings and particles stripped from Korean words, longest first: 4 syllables, 3 syllables, 2-syllable endings, 2-syllable particles, 1 syllable.
_LINTER_KO_LOOSE_SUFFIXES: Particles stripped only by the loose comparison used for warnings.
_LINTER_KO_ONLY_PARTICLE: The loose suffix that is kept after a number unit (LINTER_KO_NUMBER_UNITS).
_LINTER_KO_NEG_AUX: Negative auxiliary stem ('-ji anh-'), searched inside a word.
_LINTER_KO_DESCRIPTIVE_NEG: Adnominal negation: describes the following noun instead of forbidding.
_LINTER_KO_PURPOSE: Purpose/result endings after LINTER_KO_NEG_AUX, matched first to last.
_LINTER_KO_PURPOSE_DIRECTIVES: Directive forms of 'do' that turn a purpose clause into a prohibition.
_LINTER_KO_DO_PROSPECTIVE: 'do' in the prospective form: a directive only when LINTER_KO_NOMINALIZER follows.
_LINTER_KO_PURPOSE_CAUTIONS: Word beginnings that are prohibitive directives after a purpose clause.
_LINTER_KO_EMPHASIS: Emphasis adverbs skipped when looking for the directive after a purpose clause.
_LINTER_KO_PROHIBITIVE: Prohibitive verb in 'mal geot', as a separate word or glued to the nominalizer.
_LINTER_KO_BANS: Ban markers at the end of a word (or before LINTER_KO_BAN_ENDINGS), matched first to last.
_LINTER_KO_EXCEPTION_WORDS: Exception and contrast words (the English ones are in linter.rs).
_LINTER_KO_ANTONYMS: Korean sides of the antonym pairs in linter.rs (stems).
_AST_KO_FACTUALITY_MARKERS: Phrases that forbid content outside the data (the English ones are in ast/mod.rs).
_PROFILER_KO_ID_WORDS: Words that mark an identifier column anywhere in its name.
